title: WP-SOL-D: representative shadow calibration (badf-solution-design -> SHADOWED)
objective: Advance badf-solution-design VALIDATED -> SHADOWED by running the `solution` command retrospectively over representative composition matrices spanning the outcome space, and recording the calibration: true positives (every structural + seam defect refused), zero false positives (clean multi-requirement compositions pass), and declared non-coverage (the external-artifact seams SOL-I02/05/07/10/11 are not exercised -- they need the specialist adapters). Because BADF has no real project compositions yet, the shadow is REPRESENTATIVE and labelled so; a real re-shadow is owed on the first real use. Ship 1-2 committed representative shadow matrices, a shadow-evidence reference, and advance the registry.
business_value: SHADOWED is the rung before APPROVED/ACTIVE. It proves the composition/seam controls behave correctly across the outcome space and honestly bounds what they do NOT yet cover. Doing it on representative cases -- and saying plainly that it is representative, not real-project -- keeps the admission ladder truthful: the operator can hold APPROVED/ACTIVE for a real re-shadow if preferred, rather than a synthetic one masquerading as production calibration.
